model_output.verdict: Your move from accounts payable to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply gives me a clear direction. The accounting work is there, but I’d hesitate to move the resume forward because I can’t tell enough about what you handle at close or how much of it you do.
write_up: You’ve moved from accounts payable into staff accounting at Rivermark Building Supply. It’s common for accounting resumes to list duties this way, but yours won’t stand out in a pile yet: a recruiter can see the functions you touch, not enough of the work within them.

The line about matching purchase orders to receipts is the clearest model because it names the documents you worked with and what you did with them. Your current role and accounting degree are easy to find, but Rivermark’s business and the scale of your work are still unclear.
Let’s start with the Staff Accountant role and the month-end close line. Add the tasks you own, then give the journal entries, reconciliations and audit work enough detail to show what you handle.
